name: TAXONOMY_PINNING
findings: All taxonomy dependencies for the frozen corpus pinned with SHA-256: CNMV IPP 2019-01-01 (ipp_en+ipp_ge), ESMA ESEF 2022-03-24 (FY2024) and 2024-03-27 (FY2025), 8 xbrl.org base files, 6 issuer extension taxonomies (members of the preserved ESEF packages).
ESMA packages verified to contain the expected dated esef_cor.xsd entry point (content check).
Issuer extension taxonomy domain change confirmed: SAN santanderbank.com (FY2024) -> santander.com (FY2025).
Arelle pinned: arelle-release==2.44.0 (64bit), headless CLI; taxonomy resolution via pinned packages for offline determinism (R14/R15).
limitations: Issuer extension source_url values are identifiers resolved via the package catalog, not live fetches.
ESMA may republish taxonomy packages; a changed SHA-256 means the source changed (flag, never overwrite).
